Unified style: whimsical hand-drawn 2D cartoon game art, bold clean dark ink outlines, simple big flat shapes, vivid restrained palette, only one simple cel-shadow color per material. 1 MAGIC BOOK: a floating OPEN book, plum-purple cover with simple gold corner fittings, cream pages, just two or three simple geometric magical glyphs (diamond/star, not lettering), subtly expressive curled page tips, feels alive without human body or face. Page spread faces camera, chunky spine/book shape, no wand or projectile, no magical aura.
2 ALCHEMY CAULDRON: squat round navy-blue little cauldron, thick rim, two small side handles, three short feet, one simple gold diamond motif, bright mint-turquoise potion visible inside, just two small bubbles tightly above the opening. Friendly rounded silhouette. Potion brightness is flat paint, not bloom. No steam plume or effects.
3 GARGOYLE: small cute chunky slate-blue stone gargoyle, broad heavy crouching seated body, two stubby horns, short folded wings attached behind shoulders, sturdy arms resting on knees, tiny amber eyes and mild scowl. Wide and solid, a little larger than book/cauldron. Stone shown by flat slate colors and one simple shadow, at most two small crack marks. NO pedestal or floor.
4 SLIME: squat rounded lilac-purple blob, two small dark oval eyes, tiny simple grumpy mouth, one small cream-lavender painted highlight patch. Extremely simple body and no equipment, protruding arms or feet. Slight asymmetrical dome leaning toward front-right, wide flat squishy base.
5 HELMET SLIME: EXACT SAME lilac-purple slime as unit 4: identical body contour, width, height, color, highlight, eye positions, mouth and proportion. Add only a slightly oversized dull silver-gray rounded scavenged metal helmet with a small gold rim and one tiny dent. Eyes remain visible. No visor hiding eyes, no horns or plume, no redesign; body is an exact twin of plain slime and total size stays similar.
The book, cauldron, and plain slime occupy a similar visual footprint. Gargoyle slightly larger/wider. Helmet slime's body identical in size to slime, only helmet adds a little height.
Truly transparent background. No background paint or checkerboard, no floor, ground, cast/drop/contact shadows, scene, border, decorative frames, UI, text, particles or additional assets. Clean self-contained game units, not a concept-art poster.
